title: Read Point Cloud
text: Extract point cloud from ROS PointCloud2 message, 1 input, 4 outputs; {Maximum point cloud size} sets the maximum point cloud image size, {Preserve point cloud structure} sets the point cloud data output shape preservation, {Show RGB output port} sets the rGB port toggle, {Show Intensity output port} sets the intensity port toggle, {Show ErrorCode output port} sets the errorCode port toggle and {Output variable-size signals} sets the variable-size signal output toggle. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: RGB
ports.summary: RGB values for each point matrix | array

ports.name: Intensity
ports.summary: Intensity values for each point array | matrix

ports.name: ErrorCode
ports.summary: Error code for image conversion scalar

params.name: Maximum point cloud size
params.values: Maximum point cloud image size [480 640] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Preserve point cloud structure
params.values: Point cloud data output shape preservation off (default) | on

params.name: Output variable-size signals
params.values: Variable-size signal output toggle off (default) | on
